why: The reverse of prelude_unit: the parent file has no float literal, the candidate adds scale with one. A whole-file translation would read the candidate's numbers as reals and the parent's as integers. balance and tag reach nothing of scale, so each is translated alone with whole numbers on both sides and is PASS-proved (before this reading both were ASK:interface). scale is new: NEW, no lemma. A pair translates whole files, so lane A runs per unit through check.mjs (laneBOnly skips the whole-file theorem).
